name: manual_1fd9e4
claim: A benchmark of local-model routes must hold endpoint, temperature, template and thinking mode equal before attributing a difference to transport; the Windows MCPB-versus-direct comparison differed in all four and the Mac's 30.2 percent figure was withdrawn as a basis for preferring a route.

decisions.notes: Windows partial benchmark and source reading 2026-11-10; Mac errata on rubric weaknesses; sample sizes of 2 to 3.

rationale: Windows partial benchmark and source reading 2026-11-10; Mac errata on rubric weaknesses; sample sizes of 2 to 3.
